bootstrap: config + isPilotEnvironment + context + init + _fetchDefectManifest + _updateDisplayName (~119 lines)

sharedAppendChain.description: S123-S125 append chain runs identically in _explainAnswer, _explainWrongChoices, and _simplifyExplanation
sharedAppendChain.perInvocationLoadCalls: ~6-7 MayLearnerState.load() calls (each from localStorage) — via getTopicProgress in S123/S124/S125 generators + direct load() calls + _recordRecommendation → load()+save()
sharedAppendChain.totalLoadCallsInExplainChain: ~7-8 load() + ~3 save() calls for a single 'explain' action

duplicatedComputations.computation: Topic progress (accuracy, attempt counts) retrieved via MayLearnerState.getTopicProgress()
duplicatedComputations.unificationStrategy: Compute topicProgress once at the top of each coaching entry point (_explainAnswer, _explainWrongChoices, _simplifyExplanation) and pass it down as a parameter to all callees. In a single _explainAnswer call, getTopicProgress() is called 5 independent times, each re-reading localStorage and rebuilding the full topic map.

duplicatedComputations.computation: Section name map {A:'External Financial Reporting', B:'Planning...', C:'Performance...', D:'Cost...', E:'Internal Controls', F:'Technology & Analytics'}
duplicatedComputations.unificationStrategy: Define a single May.config.sectionNames or May._sectionNames constant and reference it everywhere. Eliminates 6 copies of the same 6-line object literal (~30 duplicated lines).

duplicatedComputations.computation: Misconception pattern name map {misclassification:'classification errors', variance_sign_confusion:'variance sign confusion', budget_component_error:'budget component selection', ...}
duplicatedComputations.unificationStrategy: Define a single shared pattern name map (May._patternNames or MayLearnerState._patternNames). Eliminates 7 identical copies of an 8-entry object (~48 duplicated lines).

duplicatedComputations.computation: Weak-topic identification — which topics are below threshold and need attention
duplicatedComputations.unificationStrategy: All seven subsystems independently identify the 'weakest topics.' MayLearnerState.getWeaknessClusters() already provides the pre-computed list. All subsystems should consume that single source of truth instead of re-deriving weak-topic lists from raw session data. Standardize on clusters.persistentWeak, clusters.declining, clusters.unstable as canonical weak-topic sources.

duplicatedComputations.computation: Hint level dispatch — switch on hintLevel (metacognitive→concept→strategy→elimination)
duplicatedComputations.unificationStrategy: Extract a shared _dispatchHint(q, level, caseObj) function that both _provideHint and miniHint call. Currently miniHint duplicates the MCQ switch but lacks case support, creating a consistency risk.

duplicatedComputations.computation: Cross-session accuracy trend (recent vs. prior session comparison)
duplicatedComputations.unificationStrategy: Extract a _computeSessionTrend(sessions, windowSize) utility. All three compute essentially the same metric (recent accuracy delta) but with slightly different windows.

duplicatedComputations.computation: Misconception pattern scan for current topic from learnerState data
duplicatedComputations.unificationStrategy: Compute once at the entry point. All three do: data = MayLearnerState.load(); patterns = data.misconceptionPatterns.filter(p => p._topics.includes(topic) && p.count >= 2). Pass as parameter.

duplicatedComputations.computation: Session topic classification — building {topic: {n, c}} maps from session attempts
computedIn: S126:_generateSessionRecap ~lines 2962-2989 (receives pre-computed entries but may iterate again)
duplicatedComputations.unificationStrategy: MayLearnerState could expose a getSessionTopicSummary(sessionId) that returns pre-aggregated topic counts from a cached store. Currently each function independently iterates session.attempts[].

redundantScans.dataQueried: MayLearnerState.load() — reads full learner state from localStorage and parses JSON
queriedBy: MayLearnerState.getTopicProgress() [called independently from many May.* functions]
redundantScans.worstCaseSingleAction: In a single _explainAnswer invocation, MayLearnerState.load() is called 7-8 times indirectly (via getTopicProgress in S123, S124, S125 generators + direct load() in S124/S125 + _inferReviewFocus + _recordRecommendation × 2-3). In a single renderView(), load() is called 15-20 times through cascading getTrends/getWeaknessClusters/getReadinessSummary/getTopicProgress/getCasePatternSummary chains.

redundantScans.dataQueried: Session history iteration — scanning all sessions/attempts arrays
queriedBy: MayLearnerState.getReadinessSummary() — massive iteration through trends, topicProgress, casePatternSummary
MayLearnerState.getLongitudinalAnalytics() — iterates sessions filtered by 3 time windows

redundantScans.dataQueried: MayLearnerState.getTopicProgress() — rebuilds full topic map from localStorage on every call

redundantRecommendations.recommendation: "Focus on / practice more on weak topic X"
redundantRecommendations.unificationStrategy: All six identify the same data (weakest topic) and generate the same core message. Route through a single _recommendFocusTopic(topic, context) that varies framing by context (next-session vs. weekly vs. recovery-set).

Seven subsystems independently surface misconception patterns using nearly identical code (load → filter data.misconceptionPatterns → sort by count → map pattern name → format). Extract a _formatMisconceptionInsight(patterns, style) that takes pre-filtered patterns and a display style ('coaching', 'digest', 'strategy').

generatedBy: S123:_generateNextBestStep (action plan for calculation/ formula errors, ~lines 1131, 1135)
S128:_generateStudyStrategy (work 5-6 items mixing concept and calculation, ~line 3270)
redundantRecommendations.unificationStrategy: Centralize formula-first coaching language in a shared _getCalculationCoaching(topic, context) that returns the appropriate message variant (hint, trap, action plan, strategy) from one canonical source.

redundantRecommendations.recommendation: "Maintain / review strong topic to prevent decay"
redundantRecommendations.unificationStrategy: Four subsystems independently detect and surface strong topics. Route through a single MayLearnerState.getStrongTopics() that returns the canonical list, and format display from one location.

generatedBy: S126:_generateSessionRecap (~line 3044: 'consider mixing in a case study')
redundantRecommendations.unificationStrategy: getAdaptivePracticeMix() already determines the optimal practice mode. All coaching paths should consume that single decision rather than independently re-deriving case-study recommendations.

memoryGrowthRisks.cap: Sessions capped at 50, but attempts per session are unbounded
memoryGrowthRisks.detail: Each session's attempts array grows without a per-session cap. A single session with 200+ MCQ attempts would store 200 objects. The 50-session cap limits total sessions but not per-session bloat.
memoryGrowthRisks.mitigation: Add per-session attempt cap (e.g., 100) or cap total attempts across all sessions.

memoryGrowthRisks.detail: Each misconception pattern entry accumulates questionIds indefinitely: existing.questionIds.push(qid). No cap, no deduplication beyond Set conversion at push-time. A pattern with 200+ occurrences stores 200 question IDs.
memoryGrowthRisks.mitigation: Cap questionIds at 50 per pattern or track count only.

memoryGrowthRisks.dataStructure: May._topicIndex (in-memory cache of all certified bank questions)
memoryGrowthRisks.cap: Bounded by bank size, never cleared
memoryGrowthRisks.detail: Built lazily on first _findSimilarQuestions call. Lives for page lifetime. With 5 banks × ~300 questions each ≈ 1500 question objects. Acceptable for now but could grow with bank expansion.
memoryGrowthRisks.mitigation: Consider weak-ref caching or LRU eviction if bank count grows beyond 10.

memoryGrowthRisks.detail: Properly capped. Reset per-question in setQuestionContext.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Implement a per-action compute-once pattern: load learner state once at the entry point of each high-level coaching action (_explainAnswer, _explainWrongChoices, _simplifyExplanation, renderView) and pass the loaded data + pre-computed topicProgress/weaknessClusters as parameters to all callees.
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Reduces localStorage reads from ~7-8 per _explainAnswer to 1. Reduces getTopicProgress() calls from 5 to 1 per explain chain. Eliminates ~80% of redundant getTrends()/getWeaknessClusters() calls in renderView(). Estimated 60-70% reduction in total load() calls across all coaching paths.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Extract duplicated constant maps into shared module-level constants: May._sectionNames, May._patternNames. Define once, reference everywhere.
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Eliminates 6 copies of sectionNames (30 lines) and 7 copies of patternNames (48 lines). Reduces maintenance burden — a single change updates all subsystems. Prevents drift between copies.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Consolidate weak-topic recommendation generation: route all 'focus on topic X' recommendations through a single _recommendFocusTopic(topic, context) function. Have S125, S126, S127, S128, _recommendNext, and _generateRecoverySet all call this shared function with different context flags (next-session, weekly, recovery-set).
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Eliminates 6 independent implementations of the same logic. Ensures consistent messaging. Reduces ~50 lines of duplicated topic-prioritization code.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Create a MayLearnerState.getCachedLearnerSnapshot() that returns {data, topicProgress, trends, weaknessClusters, caseSummary} in a single localStorage read. Use this as the entry point for renderView(), _getProgressInsight(), _getWeaknessInsight(), and _generateWeeklyDigest().
optimizationRecommendations.impact: renderView() currently triggers 15-20 independent load() calls through cascade chains. A single snapshot would reduce this to ~3 calls (snapshot + a few specialized queries). Eliminates N+1 query pattern in the render path.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Consolidate S126-S127-S128 into a single longitudinal analytics pipeline. All three independently iterate session history, compute topic accuracy, identify weak/strong topics, scan misconception patterns, and generate recommendations. They differ only in time window (single session vs. 7 sessions) and output framing.
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Reduces ~476 lines across three subsystems to ~200 lines in a unified pipeline with window-parameterized output. Eliminates duplication in session scanning, topic classification, pattern detection, and recommendation generation.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Implement a lightweight in-memory cache for MayLearnerState.load() with a session-scoped TTL. Cache the parsed learner state object for the duration of a single user action + render cycle, then invalidate.
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Without changing any function signatures, reduces localStorage reads by 80% for cascading calls. A simple lastLoadTimestamp + cachedData check in load() would short-circuit repeated deserialization of the same data.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Add per-session attempt caps in MayLearnerState.recordAttempt(): if session.attempts.length > 100, trim oldest. Also cap misconceptionPatterns[].questionIds at 50.
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Prevents unbounded growth in the two remaining uncapped data structures. Ensures localStorage quota is never exceeded even with heavy usage.

optimizationRecommendations.change: De-duplicate hint dispatch between _provideHint() and miniHint() by extracting a shared _dispatchHint(q, level, caseObj) function.
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Ensures miniHint() gains case-item support (currently missing). Eliminates ~15 lines of duplicated switch statement. Prevents divergence between full-panel and mini-panel hint behavior.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Extract cross-session trend computation into MayLearnerState.getSessionTrend(windowSize) to serve S126, _summarizeSession, and S127 from one implementation.
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Eliminates 3 independent implementations of 'compare recent session accuracy to prior session.' Reduces ~25 lines of duplicated computation.

optimizationRecommendations.change: Add a MayLearnerState.getTopicSnapshot(topic) that returns {accuracy, recentPct, attempts, patterns} in one call. Use it to replace the pattern of: getTopicProgress() + load() + filter misconceptionPatterns.
optimizationRecommendations.impact: Reduces 3-call patterns to 1. Used in S124, S125, _explainYourMistake which all do the same 3-step dance.
